caption: The drawing depicts a wooden figurine of a chicken or rooster mounted on a rectangular base. The figurine is painted in earthy tones, primarily shades of brown, yellow, and black. The head of the bird is black with a reddish-brown comb on top and a red wattle hanging below the beak. The body is yellowish-brown with darker brown spots or markings along the side. The tail, which curves upward, is a darker brown with lighter streaks. The bird is supported by a cylindrical post attached to a two-toned rectangular base, with the top of the base colored dark brown and the sides in a lighter brown. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Pa. German Toy Rooster
